objective: Build RESILINK GRID Hub backend (/hub) with FastAPI, SQLite WAL, cryptographic ingest, replay protection, canonical JSON audit hash chain, deterministic offline emergency engine, facility services, Groot voice/chat gateway, and full test suite
acceptance_criteria: Ingest order enforced: length -> version -> expiry -> replay -> signature -> store
NACK error codes implemented: BAD_LENGTH, BAD_VERSION, EXPIRED, REPLAY, BAD_SIGNATURE, UNKNOWN_DEVICE, REVOKED, UNKNOWN_EPOCH, NO_BASE
2048-bit sliding bitmap + unique index replay filter with TTL logic in SQLite WAL transaction
Isolated schemas for medical, operational, infrastructure, audit (never joined)
Audit hash chain with RFC 8785 canonical JSON, HMAC/SHA-256, signed checkpoints, and /v1/audit/verify pinpointing first bad seq
F4 metadata-only triage queue and documented fine ranking formula for doctor client
F3 signed snapshot request relay and NO_BASE keyframe handling
F5-F7 facility service with seeded Bangalore data, haversine query, near-expiry drug flagging (<30 days), and mutation simulator
F8 deterministic offline emergency allocation (nearest ambulance, weighted hospital scoring, fallback, multi-path dispatch, outbox retry, idempotency, state machine, human override)
Groot gateway with intent router over aggregates, strict zero-ciphertext/key isolation, safety disclaimer, GROOT_QUERY audit, and wake-to-answer latency measurement
Unit and integration test suite passing for T2-T9, T13, T15, T17, T18, and allocation edge cases
Deliverables: OpenAPI spec, seed data, run script (make run / run.py), demo script, and comprehensive README
non_goals: Do not decrypt patient ciphertext on hub (hub never holds keys or plaintext)
